_comment: MenuEngine dish library. Keyed lookup by name (case-insensitive, with fuzzy contains). desc = simple explanation everyone can understand. media query defaults to name; the app builds YouTube/photo search links from it.

dishes.name: Pad Krapow Gai
dishes.desc: Thai street-food classic: minced chicken stir-fried with holy basil, garlic and chili, served over rice — usually topped with a crispy fried egg.
dishes.ingredients: Minced chicken, holy basil, garlic, chili, soy & oyster sauce, rice, fried egg

dishes.name: Tom Kha Gai
dishes.desc: Mild, creamy coconut soup with tender chicken, galangal, lemongrass and lime — soothing and not spicy.
dishes.ingredients: Chicken, coconut milk, galangal, lemongrass, kaffir lime, mushroom

dishes.name: Tom Yum Goong
dishes.desc: Famous hot-and-sour Thai soup with shrimp, lemongrass, lime and chili — bright, zingy and aromatic. Heat is adjustable.
dishes.ingredients: Shrimp, lemongrass, galangal, lime, chili, mushroom

dishes.name: Som Tum
dishes.desc: Green papaya salad pounded with lime, chili, garlic, tomato and peanuts — fresh, tangy and crunchy.
dishes.ingredients: Green papaya, lime, chili, garlic, tomato, peanuts, fish sauce

dishes.name: Green Curry
dishes.desc: Coconut curry with green chili paste, Thai eggplant and chicken — fragrant with basil; medium heat.
dishes.ingredients: Chicken, green curry paste, coconut milk, Thai eggplant, basil

dishes.name: Massaman Chicken
dishes.desc: Rich, mild southern-Thai curry with tender chicken, potatoes and peanuts — gently sweet and warmly spiced, not hot.
dishes.ingredients: Chicken, massaman paste, coconut milk, potato, peanuts, cinnamon

dishes.name: Panang Curry
dishes.desc: Thick, creamy red curry that's milder and sweeter than green curry, with a deep peanut note.
dishes.ingredients: Chicken or pork, panang paste, coconut milk, kaffir lime

dishes.name: Pad Thai
dishes.desc: Stir-fried rice noodles with egg, tofu or shrimp, beansprouts and peanuts in a sweet-tangy tamarind sauce.
dishes.ingredients: Rice noodles, egg, tofu/shrimp, beansprouts, tamarind, peanuts

dishes.name: Pad See Ew
dishes.desc: Wide rice noodles stir-fried in dark soy with egg and Chinese broccoli — smoky and savory, not spicy.
dishes.ingredients: Wide rice noodles, egg, Chinese broccoli, dark soy

dishes.name: Khao Man Gai
dishes.desc: Thai-style poached chicken over rice cooked in chicken stock, with a gingery dipping sauce — clean and gentle.
dishes.ingredients: Poached chicken, rice, ginger, garlic, soybean sauce

dishes.name: Chicken Satay
dishes.desc: Grilled marinated chicken skewers with a creamy peanut dipping sauce — smoky and lightly sweet.
dishes.ingredients: Chicken, turmeric, coconut, peanut sauce

dishes.name: Larb
dishes.desc: Zesty minced-meat salad (chicken or pork) with lime, herbs, chili and toasted rice powder.
dishes.ingredients: Minced chicken/pork, lime, mint, chili, toasted rice

dishes.name: Khao Pad
dishes.desc: Thai fried rice with egg and vegetables — simple, comforting and quick.
dishes.ingredients: Rice, egg, onion, soy sauce, vegetables

dishes.name: Jok
dishes.desc: Thick Thai rice porridge (congee) with minced pork, ginger and a soft egg — very soft and soothing.
dishes.ingredients: Rice, minced pork, ginger, egg, scallion

dishes.name: Mango Sticky Rice
dishes.desc: Sweet sticky rice with coconut cream and ripe mango — Thailand's beloved dessert. High in sugar.
dishes.ingredients: Sticky rice, coconut milk, sugar, mango

dishes.name: Kung Pao Chicken
dishes.desc: Sichuan stir-fry of chicken with peanuts and dried chili — savory, a little sweet, with a tingly kick.
dishes.ingredients: Chicken, peanuts, dried chili, Sichuan pepper, soy

dishes.name: Mapo Tofu
dishes.desc: Soft silky tofu in a spicy, savory Sichuan sauce with a little minced pork — soft texture, bold flavor.
dishes.ingredients: Tofu, minced pork, doubanjiang, Sichuan pepper

dishes.name: Sweet & Sour Pork
dishes.desc: Crispy battered pork tossed with pineapple and peppers in a tangy-sweet sauce — kid favorite.
dishes.ingredients: Pork, pineapple, bell pepper, vinegar, sugar, ketchup

dishes.name: Yangzhou Fried Rice
dishes.desc: Classic fried rice with egg, shrimp, char siu pork and peas — a meal in itself.
dishes.ingredients: Rice, egg, shrimp, char siu, peas, scallion

dishes.name: Char Siu

dishes.name: Pork Dumplings

dishes.name: Hot & Sour Soup

dishes.name: Beef & Broccoli

dishes.name: Wonton Noodle Soup

dishes.name: Chicken Congee

dishes.name: Dim Sum
